description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Background that modifies background attributes in HTML to convert proprietary background attributes into CSS background-image properties.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Background
classes.description: A class that transforms proprietary background HTML attributes into CSS background-image style.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the 'background' attribute into a CSS background-image property by prepending a CSS rule.
